name: a label that fits its area in a single row of the grid has places half a row above and below
$comment: A 360 × 36 px strip and a label 12.288 px tall with 2.4 px of inner padding: its center fits between y = 38.544 and 57.456, where the grid (spacing 12.288 from y = 36.144) has a single row, y = 48.432, which a hard wall from y = 51.5 to 53.5 blocks, as it blocks the pole. The points half a spacing below the grid's are sampled as well (spec §6.5): the row y = 42.288 above the wall takes the label, which otherwise leaves the strip on a leader.
